content.title: Dunkin' Rewards | Dunkin'®
content.text: The best things in life are free — like Dunkin’ Rewards! Join millions of members who save on Dunkin’ every day with exclusive offers and use their points for FREE food and drinks. We double Dunkin' dare ya. As a member, you’ll earn 10 POINTS PER $1 SPENT on qualifying purchases in-store and in the Dunkin’ App. Visit 12 times in a calendar month to unlock Boosted Status and start earning 12 POINTS PER $1 SPENT for 3 months. Exclusive offers, discounts and surprises – including an annual 3X POINTS BONUS for your birthday – are waiting for you! Start earning exclusive Dunkin’ Rewards badges, and check out your collection any time in the Dunkin’ App. A slider having 1 slides per page and moves 1 slides when goes to next or previous page. *Exclusions apply. Check the Dunkin’ App to learn more. *Exclusions apply. Check the Dunkin’ App to learn more. 3-count MUNCHKINS® Donut Hole Treats, 6-count Hash Browns, Cold Foam drink topping, or Espresso Shot, Extra Swirl, Extra Syrup, Coffee Milk or Lemonade drink add-in. A small, medium or large Hot or Iced Coffee or Tea. A small, medium or large Dunkin’ Refresher, Hot Chocolate, or Hot or Iced Chai Latte or Matcha Latte. 10-count MUNCHKINS® Donut Hole Treats, muffin or Iced Loaf slice. A breakfast sandwich with your choice of meat, egg, cheese and bread. Wake-Up Wrap® with or without meat, Stuffed Bagel Minis, Croissant Stuffers, Snackin’ Bacon or bagel with cream cheese spread. Any size hot or iced espresso drink, frozen drink, Shakin’ Espresso, Cold Brew, Signature Latte or Dunkalatte™.
